localTools: npm (npm ci installs pinned Remotion 4.0.532, React 19, zod, tsx)
FFmpeg with libx264, AAC, loudnorm, blackdetect, freezedetect, silencedetect and lavfi sources
Chrome Headless Shell (downloaded once by Remotion on first render; or set MEMOIR_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE)

providers.name: Cartesia Sonic
providers.purpose: Four natural-rate narration windows in a public stock voice or a consented clone of the maker.

providers.name: Meta Muse Image 1.0
providers.purpose: Character candidates and sheets, backgrounds and full-quality shot keyframes (~$0.01/image).

providers.name: Seedance 2.0 Mini 480p via Replicate
providers.purpose: Image-to-video clips (one of REPLICATE_API_TOKEN or SEADANCE_API_KEY is required).

providers.name: SeaDance direct API
providers.purpose: Alternative video route used by app providers.ts generateSceneVideoClip.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.purpose: Optional automated media review or Gemini Omni animation.

providers.name: ElevenLabs
providers.purpose: Optional music bed and sound effects (disabled by default).

notes: node runner.mjs check reports missing key NAMES only; values are never printed or stored.
Validation, planning, rendering, inspection, smoke and the placeholder pipeline proof make zero provider calls.
The placeholder proof uses macOS say for placeholder narration when available, otherwise an FFmpeg tone.
Tested on macOS (Apple Silicon). Other platforms are untested.
